_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior porch ceiling repaint (combined assessment + prep + prime + finish). Context prefix PCRP (Porch Ceiling RePaint) confirmed — no collision with existing prefixes. TSK_PRCH_* is consumed by NC porch ceiling (31 tasks). TSK_PCRP_* has zero existing usage. MOD_PCRP_* has zero existing usage. Verified against all context_prefixes_in_use: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, XTRM, SFIT, XWIN, TRRP, DRRP, WNRP, XWRP, SFRP, PRCH. PCRP is unique.

paintable_items.name: Exterior porch ceiling field surface
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_PORCH_CEILING_EXT_NC_v1. Same physical surface in RP context. SF-based (porch width x porch length). Covers wood and fiber cement substrates.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_PRCH_* is NC porch ceiling (31 tasks). TSK_PCRP_* has zero existing usage. PCRP is unique for porch ceiling repaint.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_PCRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. All RP tasks use PCRP_ prefix (both transferred and new). Shared RRP tasks retain TSK_RRP_EXT_* prefix.

expected_modules.notes: Floor protection, furniture cover/removal, fixture masking, fascia/wall masking, siding masking, equipment setup.
Shared RRP module. Lead screening, containment, wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, teardown. Conditional: pre-1978 + lead.
Condition assessment: visual inspect, adhesion test, mildew/algae, moisture probe, caulk condition.
Low-pressure wash, mildew biocide, chalk remediation, scrape/feather, degloss/scuff, caulk repair, dust cleanup.
State-driven primer: chalk-binding (chalking), acrylic stain-block (failing/peeling wood), alkali-resistant (failing/peeling FC).
Finish coat 1: cut-in + brush/roll or spray + groove brush-back.
Intercoat inspection, sand (QT4), touch-up, dust removal.
Final inspect, touch-up, protection teardown, equipment clean, site cleanup, customer walkthrough.

paintscope_keys.description: Number of porch sections/elevations in scope

quality_tier.notes: QT5 excluded — porch ceiling is a field surface. QT2=economy (1 finish). QT3=standard (2 finish). QT4=premium (2 finish, interstage sand).

application_method.notes: Both ALWAYS eligible. No vent constraint (key difference from soffit). spray_backroll NOT valid (overhead).

sheen.notes: Overhead surfaces: flat and satin only.

existing_systems_to_reuse: SYS_EXT_PRCH_PRIMER_ALKALI (NC alkali-resistant primer — spot prime in RP)
SYS_EXT_PRCH_FINISH_STANDARD (NC standard finish — same product in RP)
SYS_EXT_PRCH_FINISH_PREMIUM (NC premium finish — same product in RP)
new_systems_proposed: SYS_EXT_PCRP_PRIMER_ACRYLIC_RP (RP-specific acrylic stain-block for exposed wood)

cross_spec_coordination.shared_module: MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT — shared with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP, SF_SOFFIT_EXT_RP, all exterior RP specs
deduplication_notes: RRP containment per-elevation — do not duplicate when running with other exterior RP specs on same elevation
Porch floor protection is THIS spec's responsibility — not shared with trim or soffit
Fascia masking at porch ceiling edge is THIS spec's responsibility

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Repaint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for porch ceiling repaint. NC sibling exists (SF_PORCH_CEILING_EXT_NC). Follows established NC/RP pattern.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Porch Ceiling Repaint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific primer for exposed bare wood areas on previously painted porch ceiling. Same product family as SYS_EXT_SFRP_PRIMER_ACRYLIC_RP but porch ceiling context.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Porch Ceiling
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific chalk-binding primer for SS_EXT_CHALKING on porch ceiling. Same product family as SYS_EXT_SFRP_PRIMER_CHALK_BIND.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Porch ceiling substrate material type
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Porch ceiling needs its own substrate type enum key (wood/fiber_cement only — no vinyl). Cannot reuse soffit substrate type key which includes vinyl.
